text:
My Claude Code session hasn't written code in weeks. It's a director: every task goes to a local CLI worker in tmux, tracked by an on-disk ledger.

New: who gets the task and at what effort is decided by @typesafeai Jev — a decision model, not an LLM. 6 typed answers, ~1s.
